title: He Dropped the Ball for a Stick?! 🐶😂
description:
This dog had the perfect ball… but it didn’t stand a chance. 🐶

The moment I touched his favorite stick, everything changed.
He dropped the ball like it meant nothing and chased after the one thing he truly loves.

Why are dogs so obsessed with sticks? 😂
Would your dog do the same?
